note: London landmark models (tools/kit/london/*.py -> public/models/london/<model>.glb), placed by tools/openworld/landmarks.mjs. heading: degrees clockwise from north of the model's +Y (number), 'auto' = squared to the footprint of the building at the point, or road: '<name>' = along the nearest stretch of that road (bridges: at its middle, on the deck). hide: metres round the point whose generated buildings go (their centroid), or 'footprint' = the building containing the point (hideAt: more points).
